description: This file initializes the React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the root rendering context and wraps the App component within React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React application in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element hierarchy into the root.
